races.name: Racing To School Celebrating 25 Years EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (Qual) (C/D) (GBB/IRE Incentive)
British Stallion Studs John Dunlop EBF Conditions Stakes (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Pathein
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with highest official rating but major concern over 202-day absence affecting sharpness for this tactical battle.

runners_data.name: Protection Act
runners_data.note: Hold-up style with perfect record on similar going (1 from 1) but even longer layoff of 302 days raises serious fitness doubts.

runners_data.name: Pacific Avenue
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner showing consistent recent form with strong record on good going, but headgear removal suggests confidence issues being addressed.

runners_data.name: Allegresse
runners_data.note: Only prominent runner who will actually use that style advantage, though significant class deficit against these hold-up specialists creates vulnerability late.

races.paceDynamic: Allegresse will set an uncontested lead with three confirmed hold-up horses (Pathein, Protection Act, Pacific Avenue) content to settle behind. This creates a classic front-runner's dream scenario where Allegresse can dictate fractions without early pressure, potentially stealing crucial lengths in the opening stages. The hold-up trio will converge late but may find themselves giving away too much ground to a horse that gets first run. This race shape strongly favours the pace-setter profile, as sustainable early fractions allow the leader to maintain energy for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Allegresse maintains a 2-3 length advantage turning for home without being pressed early
scenarios.body: The front-runner exploits the tactical naivety of three hold-up horses by controlling tempo completely, then finding enough late acceleration to repel challengers. Hold-up horses converge but the head start proves decisive in a small field lacking pace pressure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Class Tell Late
scenarios.trigger: If Pacific Avenue and Protection Act produce their superior finishing kicks simultaneously
scenarios.body: The two classiest hold-up performers time their challenges perfectly, with Pacific Avenue's recent consistency and Protection Act's sole win showing superior acceleration. Allegresse weakens in the final furlong having done too much alone.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pathein Sneaks Through
scenarios.trigger: If the other hold-up horses clash while Pathein finds a clear passage
scenarios.body: The highest-rated runner exploits tactical errors by his rivals, threading through as Pacific Avenue and Protection Act interfere with each other's runs. His class edge shows despite the long absence when others compromise their chances.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Allegresse goes too slow early then the field bunches dangerously at the two-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader misjudges the fractions completely, allowing all three hold-up horses to arrive simultaneously in a blanket finish. Superior stamina rather than tactical positioning determines the winner in a scramble.

watchPoints.text: Allegresse's opening two furlongs - if she goes too conservatively early, she negates her main tactical weapon
Pacific Avenue's settling - headgear removal might make her harder to restrain early, compromising her preferred hold-up style
Protection Act's movement in the preliminaries after 302 days off - any signs of ring-rustiness will be telling
Pathein's position turning in - needs to be close enough despite his hold-up style given the likely moderate pace
Rob Hornby's tactics on Allegresse - must resist going too fast but needs to establish clear advantage

races.name: Fitzdares Official Partner Of Season Opener Handicap

runners_data.name: Tropical Storm
runners_data.note: Prominent runner under in-form Rob Hornby, good recent 5f form but question marks over 27-day break after poor Windsor effort

runners_data.name: Democracy Dilemma
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner with headgear on, Daniel Muscutt rides but Robert Cowell 0/14 recent strike rate concerning despite horse's solid 5f record

runners_data.name: Spartan Arrow
runners_data.note: Prominent racer with strong 5f record under Hollie Doyle, recent Goodwood winner returning quickly and Archie Watson in good form

runners_data.name: Rosario
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who excels when pace is strong, 17-day break ideal and Roger Teal runner drops in grade after decent recent efforts

runners_data.name: Trefor
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse returning from 230-day absence but Charles Hills runner has excellent 5f record when fresh at Goodwood

runners_data.name: Rhythm N Hooves
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with consistent 5f form, Saffie Osborne partnership works well and recent efforts suggest readiness for big run

runners_data.name: Lexington Blitz
runners_data.note: Prominent type with strong recent 5f form including Goodwood win, 27-day break fits pattern and Edward Greatrex maintains momentum

runners_data.name: Clearpoint
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent recent 5f record but Simon Hodgson 0/4 recent strike rate and 41-day break may blunt finishing kick

runners_data.name: King Of Light
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from long break but has shown good 5f form when fresh, Jason Watson booking suggests stable confidence

runners_data.name: Fandom
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with solid recent form, Tyrese Cameron's 5lb claim valuable in competitive handicap and headgear changes suggest improvement expected

runners_data.name: Rogue Enforcer
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 201-day break with blinkers on, Ashley Lewis's 5lb claim helps but long absence major concern

races.paceDynamic: Democracy Dilemma will be the lone pace-setter from stall position, with Tropical Storm, Spartan Arrow, Rhythm N Hooves, Lexington Blitz, Clearpoint and Rogue Enforcer all showing prominent tendencies creating a bunched field behind the leader. The single front-runner should get an uncontested lead through steady fractions, but the wall of prominent runners will apply pressure from the 2f pole as they fan out seeking racing room. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses like Rosario, Trefor, King Of Light and Fandom who can exploit the inevitable kickback when the prominent brigade clash.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses capitalize
scenarios.trigger: If Democracy Dilemma sets sustainable fractions and the prominent pack gets bunched
scenarios.body: The lone leader creates steady pace while prominent runners impede each other seeking positions, allowing hold-up horses to sweep through late. Clean runs through the gaps will be decisive for horses with finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent pressure succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners apply early pressure and sustain their challenges
scenarios.body: Democracy Dilemma gets headed inside the final furlong as the wall of prominent runners creates genuine pace pressure. The best prominent horse with tactical speed will prevail in a driving finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front-runner dominates uncontested
scenarios.trigger: If Democracy Dilemma gets soft fractions and prominent pack hesitates
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on the field with the prominent runners failing to coordinate their challenge effectively. Democracy Dilemma kicks clear in the final furlong before hold-up horses can respond.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace collapses completely
scenarios.trigger: If Democracy Dilemma goes too slow and prominent runners also ease up
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish from the 2f pole with no genuine pace throughout. The horse with the best turn of foot regardless of running style will win in a blanket finish.

watchPoints.text: Democracy Dilemma breaking smartly and establishing clear early lead - if unopposed through first 2f, hold-up horses may struggle to peg back
Traffic problems developing 2f out as six prominent runners converge simultaneously behind Democracy Dilemma seeking racing room
Trefor's fitness levels after 230-day absence - any signs of rustiness early will compromise late challenge despite excellent fresh record
Robert Cowell's three runners Democracy Dilemma, Rhythm N Hooves and Lexington Blitz potentially working against each other tactically
Ground conditions holding up through the card - any deterioration would particularly disadvantage the returning long-absent runners

races.name: British Stallion Studs EBF Daisy Warwick Fillies' Stakes (Listed Race) (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Kissmehoneyhoney
runners_data.note: Sharp return winner at Sandown after 221 days off, sits prominent and can take advantage of sustainable pace.

runners_data.name: Crepe Suzette
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up performer with highest RPR rating who needs the strong pace this setup should provide.

runners_data.name: Tattycoram
runners_data.note: Natural front runner who will dictate the tempo without early pressure from pace rivals.

runners_data.name: Incensed
runners_data.note: Consistent prominent racer with recent course form who benefits from forward positioning.

runners_data.name: Crystal Flyer
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer wearing first-time tongue tie after 162 days off, needs strong pace to be effective.

runners_data.name: Ryka
runners_data.note: High-class closer carrying 3lb penalty who excels when able to finish strongly from off the pace.

runners_data.name: Galaxy Star
runners_data.note: Lightly raced improver who has shown stamina reserves and could benefit from patient hold-up tactics.

runners_data.name: Coedana
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid course record who can capitalize if forward group maintains advantage.

runners_data.name: Miss Wong
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 188 days who needs everything to fall right from her back-of-field position.

races.paceDynamic: Tattycoram will take the lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners in the field. The early gallop will be steady and sustainable with Incensed, Kissmehoneyhoney, and Coedana settling in prominent positions behind the leader. The genuine pace will allow the hold-up horses Crepe Suzette, Crystal Flyer, Ryka, Galaxy Star, and Miss Wong to get into contention from the back. This moderate early pace strongly favours the closers who can unleash their finishing kicks in the final three furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers Dominate Late
scenarios.trigger: If Tattycoram sets an even gallop allowing the field to stay compact through halfway
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get perfect positioning to unleash telling strikes in the straight. Crepe Suzette and Ryka have the class and finishing speed to capitalize on the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Group Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners maintain strong positions turning for home and resist the late charge
scenarios.body: Incensed and Coedana benefit from their forward positioning while the closers leave their run too late. The tactical advantage of racing handy proves decisive on this undulating track.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tattycoram Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If the leader quickens approaching the straight and opens up a decisive advantage
scenarios.body: Her natural front-running style combined with the lack of early pace pressure allows Tattycoram to dictate throughout. The field fails to peg back her advantage despite late rallies.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Kissmehoneyhoney Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the recent Sandown winner produces another career-best performance tracking the early pace
scenarios.body: Her sharp return to form and prominent racing style allows her to bridge the gap between leaders and closers. The 221-day break proves beneficial rather than detrimental.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Tattycoram gets an uncontested lead and quickens early - could steal a march on the field
Monitor how quickly Crepe Suzette and Ryka settle as their effectiveness depends on getting the fractions right
Observe Crystal Flyer's early positioning with the new tongue tie as first-time headgear can alter running style
Check if the hold-up horses get too far back in the small field as they may struggle to make up ground
Watch for any market support for Kissmehoneyhoney given her impressive return from the long break

races.name: Fitzdares Offers Top Prices At Goodwood Handicap

runners_data.name: Moving Force
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 596 days off but trainer Mark Loughnane struggling with 0/7 in last 14 days

runners_data.name: Dr Strangelove
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who needs pace to aim at, recent 11-day turnaround keeps him sharp under Daniel Muscutt

runners_data.name: Evening Saigon
runners_data.note: Likely pace-setter with excellent recent 6f form, George Wood's 1/1 record for this trainer is promising

runners_data.name: Far Above Dream
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 201 days but Hollie Doyle excels at timing late runs, needs strong pace

runners_data.name: Many A Star
runners_data.note: Nine-year-old veteran with prominent style, wearing tongue-tie and proven at this exact trip

runners_data.name: Uncle Don
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse from Robert Cowell stable that's 0/10 recently, needs everything to fall right from behind

runners_data.name: Diligently
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with excellent recent Goodwood form, Clive Cox horses running below par lately

runners_data.name: Spring Bloom
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse carrying just 116lbs after claim, needs seriously strong gallop to be effective

runners_data.name: Kiss And Run
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning after 183 days wearing tongue-tie, outsider angle if pace collapses

races.paceDynamic: Evening Saigon stands as the lone confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gates, likely getting an uncontested lead with the prominent runners Moving Force, Many A Star, and Diligently content to sit just behind. The pace should be sustainable rather than frantic, allowing the leaders to stay involved throughout. With multiple hold-up horses including Dr Strangelove, Far Above Dream, Uncle Don, and Spring Bloom needing to come from off the pace, they face the challenge of making up ground against horses who won't be stopping. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and front runners who can secure good early positions without pressure.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Evening Saigon gets the easy lead anticipated and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The uncontested pace allows him to build momentum and the hold-up horses can't reel him back in time. Moving Force and the other prominent runners also benefit from their forward positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pounce Late
scenarios.trigger: If the early leaders get caught out by a sustained finish from the handy horses
scenarios.body: Moving Force and Diligently, positioned just behind the leader, time their runs perfectly to collar Evening Saigon in the final furlong. The hold-up horses still struggle to get involved from too far back.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Hero Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Dr Strangelove or Far Above Dream get the perfect setup to unleash their finishing kicks and sweep past tiring leaders. Spring Bloom's light weight also becomes a factor in a truly-run race.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Chaos Unfolds
scenarios.trigger: If Evening Saigon goes too slow and gets swamped by everything in the straight
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace turns it into a messy cavalry charge where any horse can win depending on traffic luck. Kiss And Run's return from a long break could catch others napping.

watchPoints.text: Evening Saigon getting a soft early lead - if uncontested he becomes very hard to peg back over 6f
Moving Force's fitness after 596 days off - any ring rustiness will be exposed quickly over this sharp trip
Dr Strangelove needs the pace to develop - watch early fractions to gauge his chances
Far Above Dream's 201-day break under pressure from Hollie Doyle who may need to get creative
Uncle Don and Spring Bloom getting squeezed for room in running if the pace doesn't develop

races.name: Fitzdares Dedicated Personal Betting Service Handicap

runners_data.name: Too Hot To Tango
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who has shown consistency at this level but may struggle if pace becomes truly-run, with Hornby's 10lb claimer still finding his feet at this grade.

runners_data.name: Kokoluna
runners_data.note: Sharp prominent performer with winning form last time and Johnson Houghton's string in good order, though 23-day break could be ideal for peak fitness.

runners_data.name: Lux Aeterna
runners_data.note: Classic hold-up horse who won decisively last time at Salisbury and should relish any pace collapse, with Muscutt's 7lb claim valuable in a tight handicap.

runners_data.name: Bridge Of Eagles
runners_data.note: Hold-up type returning from 163-day absence which is a major concern despite Menuisier's ability with returning horses, needs everything to fall right.

runners_data.name: Veritable
runners_data.note: Sole front runner whose uncontested lead could prove decisive, but headgear change to plain indicates potential issues and 135-day break raises fitness doubts.

runners_data.name: Foothold
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with 8lb weight advantage who has been running consistently in similar company, though 14-day turnaround after soft ground run may have left its mark.

runners_data.name: Morbeh
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer with solid RPR who benefits from Varian's current good form, but headgear change suggests connections seeking improvement from disappointing recent efforts.

races.paceDynamic: Veritable is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate proceedings from the outset, likely setting a steady, uncontested tempo over this 1m2f trip. The prominent racers Too Hot To Tango and Kokoluna will track close behind, while the quartet of hold-up horses (Lux Aeterna, Bridge Of Eagles, Foothold, Morbeh) will be bunched at the rear. With minimal early pressure on Veritable, this creates a tactical speed scenario where the pace could slow significantly in the middle sections. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up horses who can produce late kicks against a potentially dawdling tempo.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Veritable sets a pedestrian pace unchallenged through the middle sections
scenarios.body: The back-markers get perfect conditions to unleash finishing kicks, with Lux Aeterna and Foothold ideally positioned to pounce. The front-runners become sitting ducks as the pace quickens dramatically in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Too Hot To Tango or Kokoluna apply sustained pressure to Veritable from halfway
scenarios.body: The genuine pace splits the field and favours those with tactical speed who can quicken off a true gallop. Kokoluna's recent winning form and superior RPR make her the most dangerous in this scenario.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Veritable kicks clear turning for home before the hold-up horses can organise
scenarios.body: The Gosden-trained leader capitalises on soft fractions and finds enough under pressure to hold off late challenges. His proven stamina at this trip becomes decisive when others struggle to peg him back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a crawling tactical affair with no genuine tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The sprint finish becomes a lottery where any horse with a turn of foot can prevail regardless of position. Foothold's lower weight and recent proximity to the pace in similar contests could prove crucial.

watchPoints.text: Veritable could steal a decisive advantage if allowed to coast through the middle sections unchallenged, making the prominent horses' tactics crucial early.
Bridge Of Eagles returning after 163 days needs to show immediate sharpness as hold-up horses rarely win first time back from long absences.
Foothold's 8lb weight pull could prove significant in a tight finish if the pace collapses as expected.
Too Hot To Tango and Kokoluna must commit to pressuring Veritable rather than allowing him a soft lead that suits the closers perfectly.
Any significant drift in Lux Aeterna's price would be noteworthy given his ideal racing style for this scenario.

races.name: Track Radio Launches On Monday Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners_data.name: Diamond Bay
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with solid recent form, Daniel Muscutt's 5lb claim helps significantly at this level

runners_data.name: Scarlet Moon
runners_data.note: Natural front runner returning from 231-day break, but Hollie Doyle booking suggests readiness for this tactical setup

runners_data.name: Market House
runners_data.note: Prominent style suits perfectly, Mason Paetel's claim valuable and recent Goodwood course form is encouraging

runners_data.name: Gallivanted
runners_data.note: Sharp prominent runner who handles this trip well, recent course form at Goodwood gives tactical advantage

runners_data.name: Cruden
runners_data.note: Prominent style fits but 114-day absence raises fitness concerns despite trainer's low strike rate

runners_data.name: Arcturus Flame
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up in trip, trainer's poor form (0/23) is concerning despite recent run

runners_data.name: Peking Opera
runners_data.note: Prominent runner but poor recent form and trainer's low strike rate make him hard to fancy

runners_data.name: Golden Garden
runners_data.note: Hold-up style faces tactical disadvantage with limited early pace expected, long absence problematic

runners_data.name: Autumn's Breeze
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner with 189-day break, previous Goodwood wins show ability but style doesn't suit race shape

runners_data.name: Fair Dinkum
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose recent poor form at Stratford makes him hard to recommend despite past course success

races.paceDynamic: Scarlet Moon is the only confirmed front runner and should get an uncontested lead with most others (Diamond Bay, Market House, Gallivanted, Cruden, Arcturus Flame, Peking Opera, Fair Dinkum) sitting prominent. Golden Garden and Autumn's Breeze provide the only hold-up options but face a tactical disadvantage. With no pace pressure on Scarlet Moon, this sets up as a steady gallop that will quicken late, creating a sprint finish from the 2f pole. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the pace and kick, while hold-up horses face a significant disadvantage with limited early pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Scarlet Moon sets steady fractions without pressure and the field stays bunched
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows prominent runners to travel comfortably before unleashing finishing kicks. Market House, Gallivanted and Diamond Bay are perfectly positioned to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Scarlet Moon maintains the lead and no sustained challenge materializes
scenarios.body: The mare's class edge (OR 82) and Hollie Doyle's tactical nous could see her dictate from pillar to post. Late challengers struggle to peg back the leader on this track configuration.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Success
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly in the middle stages creating gaps
scenarios.body: Golden Garden or Autumn's Breeze could benefit from increased early tempo allowing them to close strongly. This requires prominent runners to go too hard too early.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Scarlet Moon goes very slowly and the field crawls to the turn
scenarios.body: An extremely slow pace turns this into a 3f dash where any horse with a turn of foot can win. Fair Dinkum's recent form suggests he could capitalize on such circumstances.

watchPoints.text: Scarlet Moon could steal this if allowed to dictate fractions unchallenged from the front with her class advantage
Market House represents significant each-way value with the 5lb claim and proven course form
Golden Garden and Autumn's Breeze need early pace to develop for their hold-up styles to be effective
Diamond Bay's consistency makes him dangerous if settling kindly behind the leaders
Watch for any market support for Cruden despite his lengthy absence and trainer's poor recent record
